verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is mainly a terminal TUI agent (byteask-docs-1, byteask-docs-18). Its llms.txt states that VS Code, Cursor and JetBrains connectors are live (byteask-docs-28), and a runtime probe confirms editor connectors are listed there (byteask-probe-rt-1). Nothing shows what these connectors do, so there is no evidence of an in-IDE chat panel or of pulling editor context such as open files or selections; the core experience is still documented as a separate terminal session. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-IDE chat interface, a description of what editor context the connectors share, setup docs for the connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
